name: MMT-Bench
intro: MMT-Bench 是一个面向大型视觉语言模型多任务能力的综合多模态基准，包含31,325个多选视觉问题，覆盖32个元任务和162个子任务，评估视觉识别、定位、推理与规划等能力。
org: Shanghai AI Laboratory, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, The University of Hong Kong, The University of Adelaide, Zhejiang University
build_method: 多源数据, 规则生成, ChatGPT生成
task_type: 多模态理解, 多任务评测
eval_feature: 多任务, 任务地图, 视觉识别定位推理规划
scale: 31,325个多选视觉问题, 32个元任务, 162个子任务
build_method_en: Multi-source data, rule generation, ChatGPT generation
intro_en: MMT-Bench is a comprehensive multimodal benchmark for evaluating large vision-language models across multitask multimodal understanding. It contains 31,325 multi-choice visual questions over 32 meta-tasks and 162 subtasks, probing visual recognition, localization, reasoning, and planning.

flowchart LR

    C["Uniform metadata"] --> D["Manual rules or ChatGPT"]
    D["Manual rules or ChatGPT"] --> E["31,325 multi-choice questions"]
    E["31,325 multi-choice questions"] --> F["32 meta-tasks and 162 subtasks"]
    F["32 meta-tasks and 162 subtasks"] --> G["30 LVLM evaluation"]
    G["30 LVLM evaluation"] --> H["Accuracy and overall score"]

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2404.16006, the MMT-Bench project page, and the OpenGVLab repository. The benchmark retrieves datasets for task names, collates them as uniform metadata, generates questions with choices and answers using manually designed rules or ChatGPT, and evaluates 30 LVLMs over 31,325 questions, 32 meta-tasks, and 162 subtasks.
